currentText: Provide the current-year annual interest summary and confirm account ownership.
proposedText: Provide the current-year annual interest summary and confirm account ownership. Include TFN withholding amounts shown on the statement.
quote: You must show these amounts as gross interest in your tax return.
rationale: The passage requires TFN withholding amounts to be shown as gross interest, but the current wording only asks to confirm account ownership, potentially missing TFN evidence.
